@@ -1,100 +0,0 @@
-# CI: the batch gate tier, run BY HAND only (Actions tab -> CI -> Run
-# workflow). The repo has a 3000-minute monthly Actions budget (Windows bills
-# 2x, macOS 10x), so nothing runs on push or PR: gates run locally
-# (cargo xtask gate), and GitHub runs only the tag-driven release build.
-# The Windows job runs cargo xtask gate batch - every debug suite
-# minus xtask's SLOW_BINARIES (golden_cl and the regression suites
-# included), the ui suites from crates/ui, clippy with warnings denied -
-# then the headless app run. The release tier (slow binaries and the
-# --ignored heavy lanes in release) is nightly.yml's.
-# Provenance: our own build law; mirrors the AGENTS.md testing layout.
-name: CI
-on:
-  workflow_dispatch:
-
-env:
-  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
-
-jobs:
-  test:
-    name: test (${{ matrix.os }})
-    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
-    strategy:
-      fail-fast: false
-      matrix:
-        # The full suite stays Windows-only: the UI test lane opens real
-        # windows (VisualRunner/kittest) and the hosted Linux/macOS runners
-        # have no GPU. M4.2's build job covers the rest of the OS map.
-        os: [windows-latest]
-    steps:
-      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
-      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
-      - name: Batch gate tier (debug suites minus slow, ui, clippy)
-        shell: bash
-        run: cargo xtask gate batch
-      - name: Gate logs
-        if: always()
-        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
-        with:
-          name: gate-logs-batch
-          path: gate-logs/
-          if-no-files-found: ignore
-      - name: Headless app run
-        shell: bash
-        run: cargo run -q -p camcraft-ui -- --headless
-
-  # M4.2: the same code on the rest of the OS map. Everything that runs
-  # without a GPU: the golden byte-parity suites (the cross-platform float
-  # claim) and the pure-computation crate tests. The UI window lane stays
-  # on the Windows job above.
-  build:
-    name: build+parity (${{ matrix.os }})
-    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
-    strategy:
-      fail-fast: false
-      matrix:
-        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
-    steps:
-      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
-      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
-      - name: Workspace check (all targets)
-        shell: bash
-        run: cargo check --workspace --all-targets
-      - name: Golden regression suite (byte parity)
-        shell: bash
-        # M4.2b retired the two named dome-golden skips: the 3D-finish
-        # scan, hull and arc splits are quantized off the platform's
-        # libm, so Linux/macOS match Windows bit-for-bit again.
-        run: >-
-          cargo test -p camcraft-app
-          --test golden_cl --test posting --test fanuc_post
-          --test project_roundtrip --test regression_models -- --test-threads=4
-      - name: Split crate tests
-        shell: bash
-        run: >-
-          cargo test -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-cl
-          -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion
-          -- --test-threads=4
-
-  # M4.2 WASM rung: the post engine (CPS scripts in, NC out) must keep
-  # compiling for the web target; its runtime harness belongs to the
-  # web-sys-mvp rung, not this check. Manual only, like every job here.
-  wasm:
-    name: wasm compile
-    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
-    steps:
-      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
-      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
-      - run: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown
-      - name: Post engine for wasm32-unknown-unknown
-        shell: bash
-        run: cargo check -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-geometry --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
-      # #31 (M13.3) rung 1: the domain layer, flecs' C included, builds and
-      # links for wasm32 through the pinned wasi-sysroot (web/build-app-wasm.sh
-      # says why each workaround is there). Rungs 2-3: the same script then
-      # links the UI (camcraft_ui.wasm, a cdylib), runs the wasm-bindgen CLI
-      # pinned by Cargo.lock over it and lays out the page in target/web.
-      # Running that page in a browser here is still owed.
-      - name: App (flecs + domain) for wasm32-unknown-unknown
-        shell: bash
-        run: web/build-app-wasm.sh

@@ -1,32 +0,0 @@
-# Full gate, run BY HAND only (no schedule - a daily run would spend the
-# monthly Actions budget in under two weeks). The release gate tier
-# (cargo xtask gate release) - every debug suite including xtask's
-# SLOW_BINARIES, the ui suites from crates/ui, clippy, then the --ignored
-# heavy lanes of camcraft-motion and camcraft-app in release. The batch
-# tier is ci.yml's, also run by hand only.
-# Provenance: our own build law; mirrors the AGENTS.md testing layout.
-name: Nightly
-on:
-  workflow_dispatch:
-
-env:
-  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
-
-jobs:
-  release-tier:
-    name: release tier (windows-latest)
-    runs-on: windows-latest
-    timeout-minutes: 240
-    steps:
-      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
-      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
-      - name: Release gate tier
-        shell: bash
-        run: cargo xtask gate release
-      - name: Gate logs
-        if: always()
-        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
-        with:
-          name: gate-logs-release
-          path: gate-logs/
-          if-no-files-found: ignore

@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+﻿## #1415 - Remove the unused ci.yml and nightly.yml workflows
+
+**What was decided.** `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `nightly.yml` are
+deleted, and every live text that named them (AGENTS.md "GitHub Actions
+minutes are budgeted", README.md, scripts/README.md, the site's gates page)
+now says GitHub runs only `release.yml` on a pushed tag (with
+`aur-package.yml` as a job it calls). `PROCESS_VERSION` goes 54 -> 55.
+History files (CHANGELOG.md, RECOMMENDED.md, release notes) are left as
+they were.
+
+**Why.** The maintainer asked (2026-11-13: "so we can remove ci.yml and
+nightly.yml as a docs change."). Both had only a `workflow_dispatch`
+trigger; `ci.yml` last ran on 2026-11-06 and `nightly.yml` has no run in
+the last 100. Every gate tier runs locally with `cargo xtask gate`, so the
+files were dead weight that the docs had to keep explaining.
+
+**Considered and dropped.** Keeping them manual "for the rare case a
+clean-machine run is wanted": nobody used that path, and a clean-machine
+gate run on GitHub is the subject of issue 1413 (cut pipeline on a
+self-hosted Linux runner), which would replace them anyway.
+
+**Cost to change later.** Restore from git history
+(`git log -- .github/workflows/ci.yml`); no code depends on the files.
